sloka: यावदुत्पाटयामासुर्वृक्षान् शैलान् वनौकसः।तावत् प्रासहताः पेतुर्वज्रकृत्ता इवाचलाः ।। ६.६९.७५ ।।
transliteration: yāvadutpāṭayāmāsurvṛkṣān śailān vanaukasaḥ।tāvat prāsahatāḥ peturvajrakṛttā ivācalāḥ ।। 6.69.75 ।।

translations.english: With lance that looked like death and the spear glowing like the Sun, Naranthaka routed the Vanaras, who fell down.
